articles.title: Mystery surrounds why an OG burned $1M in Bitcoin
articles.snippet: The million dollar question is what prompted a Bitcoin OG to send 20 BTC to a custodian, retrieve it back, and then deliberately burn it?

articles.title: Stellar tokenized RWA market more than quadruples to nearly $4B
articles.snippet: Stellar’s real-world asset market has expanded rapidly this year as institutional adoption and tokenization activity grow across the network.

articles.title: Ex-White House Teleprompter Operator Fined for Prediction Market Insider Trading
articles.snippet: Gabriel Perez used his access to Trump's speeches before delivery to bet on "presidential mention market" contracts, profiting more than $107,500 before the CFTC caught up with him.
